import Base

# Horizontal convolution, with the row boundary cutting both outgoing edges.
def horizontal(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, +width: U32, +x: U32, left: U32
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells:
    case Nil{}:
      Nil{}
    case Con{+center, +rest}:
      +next = U32.inc(x)
      +edge = U32.is_eq(next, width)
      right = Maybe.default(&2, U32, List.head(&2, U32, rest), 0)
      west = Bool.pick(U32, U32.is_zero(x), 0, left)
      east = Bool.pick(U32, edge, 0, right)
      total = (west + center + east : U32)
      total <> horizontal(rest, width, Bool.pick(U32, edge, 0, next), center)

# Bands have explicit dead halos. Matching advances all four streams together.
# The inclusive sum recognizes B3/S23 as total=3 or (alive and total=4).
def vertical(
  cells: List<&2, U32>, above: List<&2, U32>,
  middle: List<&2, U32>, below: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match cells above middle below:
    case Con{alive, rest} Con{north, nt} Con{center, ct} Con{south, st}:
      +total = (north + center + south : U32)
      next = Bool.to_u32(Bool.or(
        U32.is_eq(total, 3),
        Bool.and(U32.is_eq(alive, 1), U32.is_eq(total, 4))))
      next <> vertical(rest, nt, ct, st)
    case _ _ _ _:
      Nil{}

def step(+width: U32, height: U32, +cells: List<&2, U32>) -> List<&2, U32>:
  +band = horizontal(cells, width, 0, 0)
  +stride = U32.to_nat(width)
  +halo = List.replicate(U32, stride, 0)
  above = List.append(&2, U32, halo, band)
  below = List.append(&2, U32, List.drop(&2, U32, band, stride), halo)
  vertical(cells, above, band, below)

def evolve(
  turns: Nat, +width: U32, +height: U32, cells: List<&2, U32>
) -> List<&2, U32>:
  match turns:
    case 0n:
      cells
    case 1n+remaining:
      evolve(remaining, width, height, step(width, height, cells))
